purpose: Define repository admission/control law while keeping mutable working-set admissions in a separately replayable state branch.

maintenance.standing: author identity only; labels refine cohorts and never grant maintenance standing

control_plane.exemption: only when every changed file is a control-plane path; mixed changes require admission

notes: Policy defines routing law and configuration only; mutable working-set admissions live on the repository-coordinator-state branch.
Admission determines working-set standing only. It does not ratify governance, approve code, or authorize merge.
When admitted ready-for-review work exceeds capacity, the coordinator does not choose winners; it reports capacity contention for operator resolution.
The required gate executes trusted default-branch code, validates the exact state-branch head it consumes, and receipts both policy/default-branch SHA and state SHA.
Evaluation admission remains derived from an ADMISSION_REQUESTED issue plus an APPROVED review by an authorized actor; it grants evidence/CI standing only and does not consume operator capacity.

evaluation_admission.evidence: closing-keyword link to an issue whose body declares ADMISSION_REQUESTED plus latest APPROVED review by an authorized actor

state.mutation_model: append event -> deterministic replay -> commit ledger and projection together
